scope: three existing proposed Phobos tank configurations; no fleet or demonstrated thermal continuity
heat_load_basis: declared net heat leak on tank/bottle insulation; total engine heat split equally between liquid tanks while firing. No measured coupling/attitude model. No engine heat recovery credit.

radiator.basis: optical/flux/view and filled assembly mass requirements, not a selected radiator; one emitting face, full solar exposure, no eclipse generation credit

electrical.basis: complete pack and power capability estimates; compare energy and peak rate, no credit from existing 45/80 kg electrical allocations; manufacturer selection still required

thermal_fixed_basis: estimate for heaters, separate gas/fluid heat exchangers, pump/transport, added insulation, mounts and sealed working-fluid inventory; radiator and battery added separately, existing sensing/control hardware retained
unresolved: Actual engine/environment heat paths may exceed the sensitivity bounds; attitude and radiator view factors are not established
Bottle-wall/gas and heater/liquid/loop conductance, wall/coolant transients and actuator response must deliver the derived reference-path heat rates
Thermostatic isolation must stop cold-case radiator losses; battery/thermal equipment temperature control and pack ratings remain unverified
Vapor equilibrium, effective vapor composition and latent heat are screening approximations; helium dissolution and stratification are unmodeled
Exact regulator and calibrated engine performance remain unverified; no interrupted-burn trajectory or reserve maneuver is solved
These are thermal subsystem power needs only; complete avionics, cabin and engine electrical load/generation budgets remain separate
